raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.4.0"

package:
  name: dbus-python
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/d/dbus-python/dbus-python-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 991666e498f60dbf3e49b8b7678f5559b8a65034fdf61aae62cdecdb7d89c770

build:
  number: 0
  skip: win
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - make
    - if: unix
      then: pkg-config
    # extras for cross-compilation
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - meson >=0.60.0
        - python
  host:
    - dbus
    - glib
    - meson >=0.60.0
    - meson-python >=0.8.1
    - pip >=21.3
    - python
  run:
    - dbus
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - dbus
      pip_check: true

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: COPYING
  summary: Python bindings for dbus
  description: |
    D-Bus is a message bus, used for sending messages between applications.
    Conceptually, it fits somewhere in between raw sockets and CORBA in
    terms of complexity.

    This package provides a Python interface to D-Bus.

    See the dbus description for more information about D-Bus in general.
  homepage: http://www.freedesktop.org/wiki/Software/DBusBindings/#python
  repository: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/dbus/dbus-python
  documentation: https://dbus.freedesktop.org/doc/dbus-python/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - mgorny
